title: bulk-publish Feature Generator
description: Adds spec-conformant $bulk-publish bulk data publication to an existing HAPI FHIR server

project.description: Name of the Nx server project to add the feature to

resourceTypes.description: Comma-separated FHIR resource types to publish; an entry may carry a search filter, e.g. Organization,Patient?active=true; omit to publish every supported type

transactionLagMs.description: How far behind the export start each snapshot claims its transactionTime, in milliseconds

storagePath.description: Snapshot storage path relative to the server working directory

resetOnStartup.description: Delete published snapshots on server startup

publicBaseUrl.description: Public base URL used in manifest file links when the server sits behind a proxy
